verses.translation: Song of a Psalm by David.

translations.ron: Gata este inima mea, Dumnezeule, gata este inima mea; cânta-voi şi voi lăuda întru inima mea.

verses.translation: O God, my heart is ready, my heart is ready; I will sing and sing psalms with my glory.

translations.ron: Deşteaptă-te slava mea! Deşteaptă-te psaltire şi alăută! Deştepta-mă-voi dimineaţa.
translations.grk: Ἑτοίμη ἡ καρδία μου ὁ Θεὸς, ἑτοίμη ἡ καρδία μου, ᾄσομαι καὶ ψαλῶ ἐν τῇ δόξῃ μου.

verses.translation: Awake, psaltery and harp; I will awake early.

translations.ron: Lăuda-Te-voi între popoare, Doamne, cânta-voi ţie între neamuri,
translations.grk: Ἐξεγέρθητι ψαλτήριον καὶ κιθάρα, ἐξεγερθήσομαι ὄρθρου.

verses.translation: I will give thanks to thee, O Lord, among the people; I will sing praise to thee among the Gentiles.

translations.ron: Că mai mare decât cerurile este mila Ta şi până la nori adevărul Tău.
translations.grk: Ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι ἐν λαοῖς Κύριε, ψαλῶ σοι ἐν ἔθνεσιν.

verses.translation: For thy mercy is great above the heavens, and thy truth reaches to the clouds.

translations.ron: Înalţă-Te peste ceruri, Dumnezeule, şi peste tot pământul slava Ta, ca să se izbăvească cei plăcuţi ai Tăi.
translations.grk: Ὅτι μέγα ἐπάνω τῶν οὐρανῶν τὸ ἔλεός σου, καὶ ἕως τῶν νεφελῶν ἡ ἀλήθειά σου.

verses.translation: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; and thy glory above all the earth.

translations.ron: Mântuieşte-mă cu dreapta Ta şi mă auzi. Dumnezeu a grăit în locul cel sfânt al Lui:
translations.grk: Ὑψώθητι ἐπὶ τοὺς οὐρανοὺς, ὁ Θεὸς, καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ἡ δόξα σου.

verses.translation: That thy beloved ones may be delivered, save with thy right hand, and hear me. God has spoken in his sanctuary;

translations.ron: Înălţa-Mă-voi şi voi împărţi Sichemul şi Valea Sucot o voi măsura.
translations.grk: Ὅπως ἂν ῥυσθῶσιν οἱ ἀγαπητοί σου, σῶσον τῇ δεξιᾷ σου, καὶ ἐπάκουσόν μου.

verses.translation: I will be exalted, and will divide Sicima, and will measure out the valley of tents.

translations.ron: Al Meu este Galaad şi al Meu este Manase şi Efraim sprijinul capului Meu,
translations.grk: Ὁ Θεὸς ἐλάλησεν ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ αὐτοῦ, ὑψωθήσομαι καὶ διαμεριῶ Σίκιμα, καὶ τὴν κοιλάδα τῶν σκηνῶν διαμετρήσω.

verses.translation: Galaad is mine; and Manasses is mine; and Ephraim is the help of mine head; Judas is my king;

translations.ron: Iuda, legiuitorul Meu; Moab, vas al spălării Mele;
translations.grk: Ἐμός ἐστι Γαλαὰδ, καὶ ἐμός ἐστι Μανασσῆς, καὶ Ἐφραίμ ἀντίληψις τῆς κεφαλῆς μου· Ἰούδας βασιλεύς μου,

verses.translation: Moab is the caldron of my hope; over Idumea will I cast my sandal; the Philistines are made subject to me.

translations.ron: Spre Idumeea voi arunca încălţămintea Mea. Mie cei de alt neam Mi s-au supus".
translations.grk: Μωὰβ λέβης τῆς ἐλπίδος μου· ἐπὶ τὴν Ἰδουμαίαν ἐπιβαλῶ τὸ ὑπόδημά μου, ἐμοὶ ἀλλόφυλοι ὑπετάγησαν.

verses.translation: Who will bring me into the fortified city? or who will guide me to Idumea?

translations.ron: Cine mă va duce la cetatea întărită? Cine mă va povăţui până în Idumeea?
translations.grk: Τίς ἀπάξει με εἰς πόλιν περιοχῆς; ἢ τίς ὁδηγήσει με ἕως τῆς Ἰδουμαίας;

verses.translation: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast rejected us? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?

translations.ron: Oare, nu Tu, Dumnezeule, Cel ce ne-ai lepădat pe noi? Oare, nu vei ieşi, Dumnezeule, cu oştirile noastre?
translations.grk: Οὐχὶ σὺ ὁ Θεὸς ὁ ἀπωσάμενος ἡμᾶς; καὶ οὐκ ἐξελεύσῃ ὁ Θεὸς ἐν ταῖς δυνάμεσιν ἡμῶν;

verses.translation: Give us help from tribulation: for vain is the help of man.

translations.ron: Dă-ne nouă ajutor, ca să ieşim din necaz, că deşartă este izbăvirea cea de la oameni.
translations.grk: Δὸς ἡμῖν βοήθειαν ἐκ θλίψεως, καὶ ματαία σωτηρία ἀνθρώπου.

verses.translation: Through God we shall do valiantly; and he will bring to nought our enemies.

translations.ron: Cu Dumnezeu vom birui şi El va nimici pe vrăjmaşii noştri.
translations.grk: Ἐν τῷ Θεῷ ποιήσομεν δύναμιν, καὶ αὐτὸς ἐξουδενώσει τοὺς ἐχθροὺς ἡμῶν.
